record.statement: Remind auto-detects its lexical search backend at store init with no configuration: SQLite FTS5 (probed by trying to create a virtual table in an in-memory database, since not every Python SQLite build compiles FTS5 in), PostgreSQL tsvector (a STORED generated column plus a GIN index), or MySQL FULLTEXT. If none is available the lexical arm is simply skipped and recall falls back to pure vector search.
